risk_summary: The excerpt is technically detailed and includes some quantified year-over-year impacts, but relies heavily on management judgment for collectability, impairments, fair values, useful lives, and tax realizability. COVID-19-related rent deferrals, relief, defaults, bankruptcies, and property impairments indicate elevated operating and credit risk, although the disclosure is largely standard accounting-policy language rather than crisis-oriented.
